description: Finds this account's workbooks. With no arguments, lists every workbook with its title, folder and when it last changed. With `query`, the workbooks whose title, latest prompt or text contain every word. With `describe`, the one workbook your words mean — chosen by meaning, not words — or none.

describe.description: Which workbook, in your own words, e.g. 'the Q3 cash model for Sagamore'. Returns at most one.

folder.description: Only this folder and below it, e.g. Clients/Sagamore; `/` for the top level.

query.description: Words its title, prompt or text must contain, e.g. 'tea importers'.

name: find_workbooks
title: Find workbooks
